description: Keeps every pinned version up to date; documented in documentation/en/development.md.

customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARGs annotated with `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…`.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions in one weekly PR.
Python dependencies (pyproject.toml + uv.lock) in one weekly PR.
Base images and pinned tools of the Dockerfiles in one weekly PR.
Pre-commit hooks in one weekly PR.
The project targets Python 3.14: a new Python minor is a deliberate change, only digests move.
FFmpeg tags are n<version>; its tarball checksum is not something Renovate can update.
prBodyNotes: ⚠ Before merging: check the signature of `ffmpeg-{{{newVersion}}}.tar.xz` against the FFmpeg release key, then set `FFMPEG_SHA256` in the `Dockerfile` to its SHA-256 (`sha256sum`). Until then the image build fails on the checksum, on purpose.
